summary: Iteration 21 - Testing new features: LeafletCanaryMap (interactive map), BrandRankingPanel (vehicle brand visit ranking), and brand-statistics API endpoints. All 14 backend tests pass. All frontend components verified working via Playwright.
passed_tests: GET /api/brand-statistics/brands - returns 6 brands (AUDI, VOLKSWAGEN, SKODA, HONDA, DUCATI, DAOCASION)
GET /api/brand-statistics/ranking - returns ranking with period, island filters
GET /api/brand-statistics/ranking?period=day - day filter works
GET /api/brand-statistics/ranking?period=month - month filter works
GET /api/brand-statistics/ranking?island=tenerife - island filter works
GET /api/brand-statistics/summary - returns today/week/month visits
GET /api/brand-statistics/ranking-by-island - returns matrix with 7 islands x 6 brands
POST /api/brand-statistics/record - records visit events correctly
POST /api/brand-statistics/record with invalid brand returns 400
GET /api/brand-statistics/daily-trend/{brand_id} - returns trend data
All brand-statistics endpoints require authentication
LeafletCanaryMap displays interactive OpenStreetMap with 7 Canary Islands
LeafletCanaryMap has map style buttons: Calles, Satélite, Terreno
LeafletCanaryMap has zoom controls (+, -, expand)
LeafletCanaryMap has island selector chips (TF, GC, LZ, FV, LP, LG, EH)
LeafletCanaryMap shows island details panel when clicking island chip
LeafletCanaryMap has legend (Todo OK, Con alertas, Sin dispositivos)
BrandRankingPanel displays all 6 vehicle brands with colors
BrandRankingPanel has sub-tabs: Ranking, Gráficos, Por Isla
BrandRankingPanel Ranking tab shows brand positions with entries/exits
BrandRankingPanel Gráficos tab shows bar chart and pie chart
BrandRankingPanel Por Isla tab shows island comparison matrix table
BrandRankingPanel has island filter dropdown (Todas las islas + 7 islands)
BrandRankingPanel has period filter dropdown (Hoy, Esta semana, Este mes, Este año)
BrandRankingPanel header shows: Marca Líder, Visitas Hoy, Esta Semana, Este Mes
critical_code_review_comments: LeafletCanaryMap correctly implements Leaflet with OpenStreetMap tiles and custom markers
BrandRankingPanel integrates well with backend API using authAxios
brand_statistics.py properly handles all 6 vehicle brands with MongoDB aggregation
Map styles switch between OpenStreetMap (Calles), ArcGIS (Satélite), OpenTopoMap (Terreno)
Island comparison table correctly shows all 7 Canary Islands with brand visit counts
seed_data_creation: Test data created via POST /api/brand-statistics/record endpoint (cleaned up)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 21 verified 3 new features: (1) LeafletCanaryMap showing 7 Canary Islands using OpenStreetMap with custom markers showing device counts per island, zoom controls, and 3 map styles (Calles, Satélite, Terreno). (2) BrandRankingPanel in Statistics tab showing ranking of 6 vehicle brands (AUDI, VOLKSWAGEN, SKODA, HONDA, DUCATI, DAOCASION) with charts, island filters, and period filters. (3) Brand statistics API with /brands, /ranking, /summary, /ranking-by-island, /record, and /daily-trend endpoints. Note: Visit counts are zero in dev environment - this is expected as no real visit data exists.
